description: This file contains unit tests for the NdkVideoEncoderAccelerator class, testing initialization, error handling, and encoding multiple frames within the media namespace, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: NdkVideoEncoderAcceleratorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for NdkVideoEncoderAccelerator, testing initialization, error handling, and encoding frames with different pixel formats and profiles.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, checks for support, and skips tests if unsupported.

methods.name: RequireBitstreamBuffers
methods.description: Handles buffer requirement callback, allocates buffers.

methods.name: BitstreamBufferReady
methods.description: Handles ready buffer callback, stores output metadata.

methods.name: NotifyErrorStatus
methods.description: Handles error status callback, records error.

methods.name: SendNewBuffer
methods.description: Allocates and sends a new output buffer.

methods.name: CreateI420Frame
methods.description: Creates a test I420 video frame with specified color and size.

methods.name: CreateNV12Frame
methods.description: Creates a test NV12 video frame from an I420 frame.

methods.name: CreateRGBFrame
methods.description: Creates a test RGB video frame.

methods.name: CreateFrame
methods.description: Creates a video frame of specified format, size, color, and timestamp.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs the message loop until quit.
